description: Fork of exp075 replacing all MultiHeadLut with PairVoting. Each of the C(d,2) input pairs has a dedicated learnable output vector; output = sum_i r_i * v_i where r_i is a soft rank feature. No tables, no anchor pairs lookup — pure pair-based projection. embed=24, pos=8 separate, d_qk=16, smooth_mode=True, temperature=0.1.
